# Brand Layer

> Independent design & build studio in Drammen, Norway. We design and build fast, SEO-first websites, iOS apps, and brand identities for businesses that care about the difference. Slogan: "Design meets Craft."

Brand Layer is a one-person studio founded and run by Momcilo Paunov. We take on a handful of projects a year and handle everything end-to-end: strategy, design, development, deployment, and hosting. Sites are engineered with modern tools (Next.js, Vercel) and ship with performance (sub-second LCP target), WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and analytics from day one.

Norsk: Brand Layer er et uavhengig designstudio i Drammen. Vi designer og utvikler nettsider, nettbutikker, apper og visuell identitet for bedrifter i Norge — webdesign bygget for fart, synlighet i søk og konvertering.

## Services

- Websites: fast, SEO-optimized websites with clear messaging and conversion-focused design (including Shopify storefronts and landing pages)
- App & UI/UX design: intuitive, user-centered interfaces; full-stack iOS development in Swift
- Branding & identity: logos, palettes, typography, and complete visual identity systems

## Selected work

- Fdami (2024): full-stack iOS app in Swift — prayer times, widgets, notifications
- William (2025): portfolio website for a video/photo creator
- LANDR (2026): Shopify ecommerce landing page for premium snowboard and outdoor gear by Paralympic snowboarder Niklas B. Lohne Hansen
- Brand Layer (2026): the studio's own identity system

## Process

1. Strategy — a one-week discovery sprint ending in a written brief
2. Design — designed and built in code from day one with real content
3. Deployment — modern stack, hosting and management included, 30-day polish period after launch
